question: Should maintainers land this PR as the combined signed marketplace feed verifier/config/refresh/schema/CLI stack, or require the prerequisite trust slices to land first and keep this PR to CLI visibility?
rationale: The branch spans verifier primitives, operator config, fail-closed loader behavior, SQLite snapshot state, and CLI/diagnostics output under a protected maintainer label, so automation should not choose the permanent trust and upgrade boundary.

options.title: Resolve and review combined stack
options.body: Resolve the dirty merge state, then review this PR as the combined signed-feed trust landing vehicle with current-head proof.

options.title: Land prerequisites first
options.body: Keep this PR open until the verifier, config, and refresh-state prerequisite PRs land or close, then rebase to the remaining CLI visibility delta.

options.title: Rescope the trust direction
options.body: Ask for a narrower implementation if maintainers do not want signed feed config and fail-closed behavior in core now.

recommendation.title: Resolve and review combined stack
recommendation.body: Resolve the dirty merge state, then review this PR as the combined signed-feed trust landing vehicle with current-head proof.
